description: The body telemetry POSTs to a simulator's /control/start. Built by telemetry from the building's sensors; parsed by sensor-simulator (TypeScript), aq-simulator and ap-simulator (Python). Each simulator receives only the sensors whose device kind it simulates.

rules.sensors: Replaces everything the simulator held for the building. May be empty: the simulator then stops simulating the building, so a sensor removed in the twin stops producing readings.
rules.roomId: Always a room of the building. Readings are room-keyed, so telemetry never sends an outdoor sensor.
rules.sensorType: A device kind from telemetry's catalog (`GET /telemetry/devices`), never a metric. A simulator ignores a kind it does not simulate.
rules.targetUrl: Absent on purpose. A simulator reads where to post readings from its own TELEMETRY_INGEST_URL, so no caller can redirect its signed batches.
rules.position: Optional. Where the twin places the sensor, in the twin's frame (y up). Absent when the sensor is not placed yet.
rules.rooms: Optional. Every room of the building, including those with no sensor: simulated people walk through rooms nobody measures. Room `position` is the footprint centre at floor level; `dimensions` extend width along x, height up y, depth along z. Absent means the caller has no geometry; never empty.

cases.name: a thermostat and a people counter in one room
two air-quality stations in two rooms
two placed routers in a building of three rooms, one room without a router
a router not placed yet carries no position
no sensors -- the building stops being simulated

rejected.name: an outdoor sensor
rejected.reason: roomId: must be a room; outdoor readings have nowhere to go

rejected.name: no sensors list
rejected.reason: sensors: required -- an absent list is not an empty one

rejected.name: a caller-chosen ingest target
rejected.reason: targetUrl: not allowed -- the old body let any caller redirect signed readings

rejected.name: a position missing a coordinate
rejected.reason: position: needs x, y and z

rejected.name: an empty rooms list
rejected.reason: rooms: absent means no geometry; an empty list would claim a building with no rooms

rejected.name: a room with no dimensions
rejected.reason: rooms: a room is a box, so it needs position and dimensions

rejected.name: a room with no width
rejected.reason: dimensions: every side must be greater than zero
